title: Setup: build Spring Framework #30020 (P27) at both pins offline and run its landed tests
description: Setup job for llm-dlc/loops/spring-framework-pr-links-p01-p30-brief.md, case P27 (spring-projects/spring-framework#30020: Recording application events from a test's child threads). In the worktrees $P/worktrees/P27-{fix,parent} (P = ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-pr-links-p01-p30), offline (dependencies resolved online beforehand), it builds the jars of spring-test with the Gradle each checkout's wrapper names, runs the landed test classes (JUnit4ApplicationEventsAsyncIntegrationTests JUnitJupiterApplicationEventsIntegrationTests ParallelApplicationEventsIntegrationTests TestNGApplicationEventsAsyncIntegrationTests ) at the fix and those of them that exist at the parent, keeps the jars, SHA256SUMS (jars and every class of the changed production sources) and the runtime and test runtime classpaths of spring-test in $P/artifacts/P27-ROLE, then runs the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent, where they are expected to fail or not compile, and removes the build trees. Script: $P/scripts/case_job.sh. No claims, no verifier.
expected: every step exits 0: fix and parent BUILD SUCCESSFUL with failures=0 errors=0 for the landed classes; transplant prints TRANSPLANT-FAILS-AS-EXPECTED or TRANSPLANT-DOES-NOT-COMPILE-AS-EXPECTED; clean prints cleaned P27

resources.notes: Gradle daemon -Xmx3g with the Kotlin compiler in process, plus test JVMs; buildSrc compiles once per worktree and once in the transplant copy

steps.name: P27 fix: offline build and landed tests
P27 parent: offline build and the parent's tests
P27 transplant: the fix's tests on the parent
